build_lenet5_backbone: build a LeNet5 backbone model for 32x32 grayscale image feature extraction
build_lenet5_classifier: build a LeNet5 model with a classifier head for a specified number of classes
run_lenet5_forward: run the LeNet5 forward pass on a batch of grayscale image tensors
review_lenet5_features: review the LeNet5 features module with three Conv2d and Tanh layers
test_lenet5_num_classes: test the LeNet5 classifier branch when num_classes is greater than zero
